title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・先に続くこの道よ

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I hate to admit defeat… but the competition today was unbelievable!)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: (I've still got a lot of flaws to make up for.)

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Hehe. Good thing I did this race before the Tokyo Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Now I know there's still a ways to go till I reach my full potential!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Time to pick myself up and keep improvin'! I'm comin' for ya, Oi Racecourse!
